text:
mira: Quick sync 78 - prototype for capacity controls ready. Key items: min/max inputs, visual slider, burst toggle, pool selector with small latency badges. Need quick takes on accessibility + copy + error handling. Figma: https://figma.redwood/capacity-proto

jon: Looks nice. Prefer numeric inputs first-class; slider as quick visual. When min and max are very close the slider should hide thumbs and show numbers only. Also add tiny p50/p99 next to pool name.

sam: A11y: make number inputs role=\"spinbutton\" with aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax. Slider must not be the only way to set values. If thumbs overlap announce via aria-live: \"min and max equal at X GPUs\".

alexa: Copy: replace terse labels. \"Burst\" -> \"Enable burst capacity (short-term)\". Tooltip: \"Extra capacity billed at on-demand rates; may be preempted.\" For error when min > max, show inline error next to the offending input, not a toast.

mira: Good. Also thinking about cost estimates under inputs. Should be optional (toggle in settings). Any strong objections?

jon: No objections. Keep estimates subtle and optionally hidden.

sam: Agree. Send updated frame after changes and I'll run keyboard + SR checks.

mira: Will update and post new frames by EOD. Thanks! :raised_hands:
